name: Caretta
description: Caretta helps teams inspect sales calls, search transcripts and summaries, review follow-up todos, and create or update private todos from Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Caretta to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Caretta to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://gateway.caretta.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Caretta MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Caretta provides these MCP tools: caretta_create_todo, caretta_get_call, caretta_list_calls, caretta_list_my_calls, caretta_list_todos, caretta_search_transcripts, and caretta_update_todo.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Caretta?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Caretta in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Caretta requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Caretta is developed by Caretta Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
